caption: The drawing depicts a beige or light tan vest with no sleeves, rendered in a realistic style. The vest is decorated with intricate, vertical floral embroidery running along the front edges, primarily in shades of green, pink, purple, blue, and white. The embroidery incorporates flowers, leaves, and curving stems, and is concentrated on the right side and along both lapels of the vest. A row of round, beige buttons fastens the front. The bottom of the vest features pointed ends with heavier banded embroidery, which matches the floral and leafy motif seen elsewhere. To the right of the main colored illustration, there is a faint, line-drawn outline of the vest’s back view, showing button placements and the shape but no color or decoration. The background is a plain, light tan color, and there is a small, handwritten signature or label near the lower right corner.
title: Waistcoat
